references.text: Jesus' knowledge of who does not believe and who will betray him is directly repeated in this verse where he refers to Psalm 41:10 about the one who shares bread with him.
Jesus' reference to 'the one who will betray him' is a direct fulfillment of the prophecy that the close friend who ate his bread lifted his heel against him.
In his solemn prayer, Jesus confirms that he knew from the beginning who did not believe, and that no one was lost except 'the son of destruction,' who is Judas.
Jesus expresses the same principle that certain people do not believe because they are not among his sheep, which mirrors the statement that there are some among the disciples who do not believe.
